audit.whatIsWrong: Every stage why was the generic Lux template with male pronouns, so a lane that is genuinely lost early read identically to one Lux wins.
audit.why: Akali is female. Her Five Point Strike is a 1.5s cooldown at 550 range and Twilight Shroud is 20s at rank 1 — the early lane is decided by her melee-range trade rate and the smoke, not by Lux's chip.
audit.corrected: Difficulty 8/10 stands; whys for Levels 1 through 4-5 now name Five Point Strike, Twilight Shroud and Shuriken Flip, and pronouns are corrected throughout.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart disagreed across layers on three rows: full-layer phases[4-6].side all read 'Akali' while content win[4]='Skill', win[5]='Lux', win[6]='Lux'.
audit.why: Lux wins 54.61% over 2514 games and every piece of prose on both layers — spikes[2], spikes[3], late, phases[5].why, phases[6].why — describes Lux taking over from first item. The full-layer side column was the stale half.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side becomes Skill, phases[5].side and phases[6].side become Lux, matching win[4-6] already on disk. Spikes: Akali's early Q, her level 6 Perfect Execution (120s at rank 1), Lux's first-item flip, late max-range control.

audit.whatIsWrong: The combo tell was never stated: Assassin's Mark is an auto-attack reset, and the cooldown field carried no numbers at all.
audit.why: Her passive rings a champion she hits with a spell and empowers the next attack when they exit the ring — the wind-up is the cue to move, not the ability cast. Shroud is 20s at rank 1, Shuriken Flip 16s at rank 1 over 825 range, Perfect Execution 120/90/60s.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now carries Shroud 20s, Flip 16s, R 120s at rank 1; dosFull and dontsFull bodies name the 825-range flip and the 675-range execute.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two bullet bodies were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.why: lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED on dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d.
audit.corrected: dosFull[1].d now covers wave position against an 825-range flip; dontsFull[2].d covers the execute threshold at half HP.

edits.before: You are the textbook assassin target — the lane is root-or-die, and the root better be banked when he commits.
edits.after: You are the textbook assassin target — the lane is root-or-die, and the root better be banked when she commits.

edits.before: Akali wins by landing Twilight Shroud, denying your pattern, and front-loading the violence while your kit is still stretching.
edits.after: Akali wins by trading at 550 range where Five Point Strike costs her 110 energy but costs you the exchange, then flipping in for the execute.

edits.before: E the contact, detonate, weave the passive auto, and keep Q visibly loaded — the chip is free and the root threat does the zoning.
edits.after: E her before she reaches 550 range, detonate, weave the passive auto, keep Q loaded — her Q costs 110 energy at rank 1 and she runs dry.

edits.before: Q-poking on cooldown and facing the dive with an empty root slot — Lux without the binding banked is everyone's favorite snack.
edits.after: Q-poking on cooldown, then facing Shuriken Flip with your root down — Lux without the binding banked dies to one 825-range gap-close.

edits.before: Ahead, own the geometry: E Akali off every contact, root the answers, and laser the river fights from fog — fed Lux turns vision lines into kill lines.
edits.after: Ahead, own the geometry: E her off every contact, root the flip, and laser river fights from fog — vision lines are what deny the Shroud reset.

edits.before: E-poke from max range on his last-hits — the slow zone plus passive auto is your chip engine from level 1.
edits.after: Five Point Strike is 1.5s at 550 range — she out-trades you up close, so E-poke and never stand in her range.

edits.before: Q joins: the root threat re-prices every step he takes past the wave's midline.
edits.after: Q joins, but her energy Q chips faster than your root threat zones — hold the wave back.

edits.before: Full kit: Q-E-auto with the passive detonations is a real chunk. Shield his answer and walk.
edits.after: Twilight Shroud lands: 20s at rank 1 of untargetable cover eats your Q and E — shove and wait it out.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — E every wave contact. Bank Manaflow and hold Q for his aggression, not yours.
edits.after: Lost Chapter helps, but Shuriken Flip (16s at rank 1) still closes 825 units — hold Q for the flip, not the wave.

edits.before: Final Spark online — anything the root catches dies to the laser math. The lane becomes a geometry quiz.
edits.after: Final Spark online, and so is Perfect Execution (120s at rank 1) — a coin flip on whether Q lands as she dashes.

edits.before: Luden's spike: Q-E-R deletes squishies from root range. Force him to dodge or die on every contact.

edits.before: - Akali Twilight Shroud: matchup-defining — Untargetable inside — hold your CC and burst for when she exits. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Prismatic Barrier like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Twilight Shroud (W): 20s at rank 1 and only 350 range — untargetable inside, so hold CC and burst for the exit. - Shuriken Flip (E) is 16s at rank 1: that is the punishable one. - Perfect Execution is 120s at rank 1.

edits.before: Luden's onward, every root is a kill: shove, hover the river, and Q-R the first contest. Your range decides objective setups alone.
edits.after: Luden's onward, every root is a kill: shove, hover river, Q-R the contest. Her R falls to 60s at rank 3 — track it before you commit.

edits.before: Carry through the root-laser pipeline — one binding per fight, converted at screen range; your job is owning the geometry that makes it land.
edits.after: Carry through the root-laser pipeline — one binding per fight from 1175 range, landed on the Shuriken Flip that must cross 825 units to you.
